title: Sixty-one orders
about: From the Planck length to the Hubble sphere in one pull back, a black hole at every scale it can have.

made.did: the grid in powers of ten as the ruler, the Earth and the Sun as NASA photographs
audit: a grid that never jumps, labels that ride their bodies, the Sun's real neighbours, a galaxy with arms
past the Milky Way: real galaxies from UNGC and 2MRS on the supergalactic plane, the Local Group with Andromeda and the Triangulum, Virgo, Laniakea, the cosmic web round the catalogues' reach

every thing at its own size, shrinking with the pull back: the galaxy map in eleven levels blended as mipmaps, true sizes for galaxies, the Magellanic Clouds and the Milky Way, points for stars, glows that shrink

the Milky Way by its laws: circular orbits at a flat rotation curve, an old disc, young stars born on logarithmic arms, a wheel of a bulge; stops for the virus and the cell, every caption held long enough to read
narration in the VoiceStudio profile Vladimir Surdin (OmniVoice, 48 steps): 23 lines at the film's stops, audio/scale.m4a
